optimizedDescription.value: Filesystem ChangeRepository with strict config, atomic indexed buckets, reconciled mutations, and mutation-scoped artifact writes.

optimizedContext.value:
# FsChangeRepository

## Rules
- Constructor accepts `context: ChangeRepositoryConfig` (workspace/runtime callbacks, `draftsPath`, `discardedPath`) plus `config: FsChangeRepositoryConfig` (`path: string` only); validate config with Zod. Missing active/drafts/discarded directory → `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- `createFsChangeStorageFactory()` returns `ChangeStorageFactory`; `create(context, config)` forwards parameters unmerged.
- Active/draft/discarded list, count, invalidation, reindex use one `FsChangeIndexCache` per bucket at `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/{changes,drafts,discarded}/`; repository MUST NOT directly access index files. Sort active `createdAt` oldest→newest; drafts `draftedAt`, discarded `discardedAt` newest→oldest.
- Persist `change.updatedAt`; legacy absence derives maximum of `createdAt` and history event timestamps.
- `FsChangeIndexCache.mutate(fn)` is sole index-write path: per-bucket blocking lock, always released. Atomic temp+rename; JSONL publishes before meta. Failure discards temps, prevents half-published pair. `list`/`count` lock-free.
- Freshness on list/count: `isInvalidated` → incremental rebuild; else disk presence/mtime vs `sourceMtime` → rebuild if stale; else cached index. `invalidateCache()` invalidates all buckets. Rebuild scans once, streams old JSONL, copies hits, rewrites misses, appends new, atomically publishes, updates meta.
- Internal manifest persistence projects history-derived list row; equal cached row → no write, changed row → helper upsert. Create/delete update, remove, or invalidate bucket; moves update/invalidate both buckets. `saveArtifact()`, skip, non-listing history cause no list update. Reindex methods delegate full rebuild.
- `create(change)` creates directory and atomic manifest, rejects name existing in any bucket, updates active index like first save.
- After internal manifest write in `mutate`/`mutateDraft`, re-enter `get`/`_manifestToChange` reconciliation for post-write bucket, resolve artifact types when available, persist again if reconciliation requests it, return reconciled `Change` in `{ result, change }`.
- `saveArtifact` requires name in active/draft mutation-in-progress set; otherwise reject before write. Success writes bytes only respecting `originalHash`/`force`; MUST NOT call `setFileStatus`, mutate hashes/history, or write `manifest.json`.

## Constraints
- Infrastructure implementation under `infrastructure/fs/`.
- MUST implement `ChangeRepository`, including `create`, reconciled `{ result, change }` mutations, and mutation-window-scoped byte-only `saveArtifact`.
